test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

‘A Red, Red Rose’ by Robert Burns is __a poem that tells a story and has a regular rhythm and rhyme scheme__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ballad**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"epic"** refers to a long narrative poem, often written about a hero or heroes and their adventures, embodying the values of a culture. (महाकाव्य)

 
 
• **Example: **The Iliad and The Odyssey by Homer are classic examples of epic poetry.
 
 

 
• **"Ballad" **is a type of poem or song that narrates a story in short stanzas. Ballads are known for their simplicity, narrative quality, and often a repeated refrain; they are typically set to music. (गीतिकाव्य)

 
 
• **Example: **“A Red, Red Rose” by Robert Burns is a beautiful ballad that expresses deep love and affection.
 
 

 
• Hence, given the description, a poem that tells a story with a regular rhythm and rhyme scheme aligns with the definition of a **'ballad'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Ballad**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Haiku **(हाइकु): A very short form of Japanese poetry typically characterized by three lines with a syllable pattern of 5-7-5. 

 
 
• **Example:** Haikus often capture a moment in nature with a profound sense of simplicity and beauty.
 
 

 
• **Sonnet **(सॉनेट ): A poem of fourteen lines using any of several rhyme schemes, typically expressing a single, complete thought or idea.

 
 
• **Example: **Shakespeare's "Sonnet 18" is one of the most famous love sonnets ever written.
 
 

 
• **Epic** (महाकाव्य): Already explained above.
